description.text: IDTA 02031-1 – Process Parameters Type. Complete Bill of Process (BoP) for manufacturing order MO-2026-001. Each step is a self-contained, typed parameter set directly executable by the robotic workcell or MuJoCo simulation.
Ordered sequence of all assembly steps grouped into the four DIN-72036-aligned phases.
Phase 1 – Board Setup: Place all pegs and connector holders on the assembly board.

value.value: Place connector holder for Conn_A (SIMPLE-2P) at board position (180, 150), orientation 0°.
Place connector holder for Conn_B (SIMPLE-2P) at board position (720, 150), orientation 180°.
Place INTERVAL peg peg_0001 on segment seg_ab at board position (350, 150).
Place INTERVAL peg peg_0002 on segment seg_ab at board position (550, 150).

description.text: Phase 2 – Wire Routing & Terminal Insertion: Route each wire through its peg-waypoint sequence and insert terminals into connector cavities.

value.value: Pick wire W001 (FLRY-0.5-RD, 600 mm) and route through pegs peg_0001 → peg_0002 along seg_ab. Priority: SIGNAL_1.
Insert W001 terminal (PIN-0.5) into Conn_A cavity 1 (cp_a1). Insertion direction: 0°.
Insert W001 terminal (PIN-0.5) into Conn_B cavity 1 (cp_b1). Insertion direction: 180°.
Pick wire W002 (FLRY-0.5-BK, 600 mm) and route through pegs peg_0001 → peg_0002 along seg_ab. Signal: GND.
Insert W002 terminal (PIN-0.5) into Conn_A cavity 2 (cp_a2). Insertion direction: 0°.
Insert W002 terminal (PIN-0.5) into Conn_B cavity 2 (cp_b2). Insertion direction: 180°.

description.text: Phase 3 – Protection & Fixing: Apply wire protection materials along segment seg_ab.

value.value: Apply corrugated conduit protection over full span of segment seg_ab (start 0% to end 100%).

description.text: Phase 4 – Finalization: Remove completed harness from board and transfer to downstream QA station.

value.value: Remove completed harness WH-SIMPLE-001 from board BOARD_SIMPLE_HARNESS_001 and transfer to QA transfer point.
